facts.text: The hotel is in downtown Atlanta, moments from Mercedes-Benz Stadium, the Georgia Aquarium and Centennial Olympic Park.
facts.excerpt: Moments from Mercedes-Benz Stadium, the Georgia Aquarium, and Centennial Olympic Park

facts.text: The hotel has a rooftop pool with skyline views.
facts.excerpt: A rooftop pool offers a serene escape with breathtaking skyline views

facts.text: Nest Spa is on the 16th floor and offers massages, facials and other treatments, with separate men's and women's lounges.
facts.excerpt: Discover elevated wellness at Nest Spa on the 16th floor. Restore body and mind with massages, facials and rejuvenating treatments, then unwind in tranquil men’s and women’s lounges.

facts.text: Spa services include couples massages, body scrubs and eye treatments.
facts.excerpt:
Couples Massages

Eye Treatment

facts.text: The fitness center is open 24 hours a day and offers free weights, cardio and boxing.
facts.excerpt: Free weights to cardio, boxing, and more, our gym has everything.

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites are spacious and airy, with warm, modern finishes.
facts.excerpt: Guest rooms and suites are spacious and airy, designed with warm, modern finishes and calming touches that inspire rest and renewal.

facts.text: Suites on the Mindful floor have plush bedding and marble bathrooms.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy plush bedding and marble bathrooms in our luxury hotel suites in Atlanta on the Mindful floor

facts.text: Some hotel rooms have panoramic Atlanta views.
facts.excerpt: Unwind in our hotel rooms with panoramic Atlanta views

facts.text: Room types include corner rooms, Executive rooms with executive lounge access, and a two-bedroom Presidential Suite.

facts.text: The Perch is a rooftop bar and restaurant serving fresh seafood and shareable small plates with skyline views.
facts.excerpt: The Perch at our Atlanta hotel is a rooftop bar and restaurant offering a relaxed, elevated escape above the city. With fresh seafood and shareable small plates, it blends laid-back luxury with skyline views

facts.text: Fiora Cucina Italiana serves an Italian breakfast.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a refined Italian breakfast experience at our hotel restaurant in Atlanta.

facts.text: Ledger Bar and Lounge is a cocktail lounge that blends corporate architecture with Southern hospitality.
facts.excerpt: The Ledger is a sophisticated cocktail lounge and bar in Atlanta that blends refined corporate architecture with the warmth of Southern hospitality.

facts.text: The nearest subway station is Civic Center MARTA Station.
facts.excerpt: Civic Center MARTA Station

facts.text: Parking is valet.
facts.excerpt: On-site valet parking is available at JW Marriott Atlanta Downtown.

facts.text: Rooms do not have fridges.
facts.excerpt: No, rooms at JW Marriott Atlanta Downtown do not have a fridge.

facts.text: Pets are welcome, up to two dogs per room.
facts.excerpt:
Pets Welcome

2 dogs max, 40 lbs each.

facts.text: Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.

facts.text: JW Market offers coffee, tea and matcha with grab-and-go sandwiches, salads and light bites.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy freshly brewed coffee, tea and matcha alongside grab-and-go sandwiches, salads and light bites.

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as a 5-star hotel balancing connection and solitude.
